scope: Immutable full frozen ABI28 native core address transport; no E2 acceptance claim

provider.signatureAudit: Every original declaration body unchanged; exact extern C function type at indirect call
provider.selection: NUPP_RAW_CORE bundle or linked baseline; immutable process lifetime, same indirect table route
provider.publication: Setup returns exactly105 aligned addresses inside retained code; whole publication refuses any invalid entry

transport.v2Field: importOffset, unsigned8aligned code-relative offset; importCount*8 zero bytes validated/copied before seal

extraImports.nupp_raw_thread_slot: extern C fn() -> *mut u64, one opaque zero-initialized word per thread
extraImports.nupp_raw_thread_finalizer: extern C fn(u64) -> void; address0 disables, otherwise thread-exit extern C fn(u64) receives storedword once; callback may not access TLS or unwind

transport.wordPolicy: Nupp alone allocates, interprets and reclaims arena/descriptor; bridge stores opaque words/pointers

validation.targets: lib +12 rewritten direct ABI integration targets +native_core_provider/native_raw/native_raw_bundle
validation.format: Required bin/nupp fmt --write rejects Rust syntax without rewrites; stable rustfmt used on new/owned Rust files
